map.单箱最大件数 = ⌊箱长 ÷ 件长⌋ × ⌊箱宽 ÷ 件宽⌋ × ⌊箱高 ÷ 件: Max units per carton = ⌊carton length ÷ item length⌋ × ⌊carton width ÷ item width⌋ × ⌊carton height ÷ item height⌋, taking the maximum across all 6 orientations
map.每个朝向把物品的长宽高依次对应箱子的长宽高，并预留两侧间隙。该工具按同一朝向规则: Each orientation maps item length, width and height to the carton axes and reserves clearance on both sides. The tool assumes a uniform grid of identical items; mixed, tilted or soft-packed loads need extra margin.
map.按同一朝向整齐排列计算，未考虑混装、斜放与纸箱抗压强度。: Calculated for uniform orientation; mixed packing, tilted placement and carton compression strength are not considered.
map.单侧间隙会加到物品每个方向的两侧，例如 0.5 cm 单侧间隙相当于每轴增加 1: Clearance per side is added on both sides of each axis; 0.5 cm per side adds 1 cm per axis.
map.六种朝向来自物品长宽高的全排列；工具取单箱可放件数最多的朝向作为推荐。: The six orientations are all permutations of item length, width and height; the tool recommends the one with the most units per carton.
map.软包装/缓冲余量按百分比放大物品尺寸，用于预留气泡膜、珍珠棉或纸护角空间。: Soft-pack allowance scales item dimensions by a percentage to reserve room for bubble wrap, EPE foam or paper edge protectors.
map.计算假设物品为规则长方体，且同一朝向整齐码放；异形件、圆柱件与混装场景需另做试装: The calculation assumes regular rectangular items packed uniformly in one orientation. Irregular, cylindrical and mixed loads need a trial pack.
map.结果为尺寸校核参考，实际发货还应考虑纸箱内径公差、重量限制、抗压强度与平台包装规: Results are a dimensional check. Actual shipping must also consider carton inner-dimension tolerance, weight limits, compression strength and platform packaging rules.
map.📚 深度解析：装箱方向与空间利用率: 📚 Deep Dive: Packing Orientation and Space Utilization
map.电商发货前试装：输入商品与纸箱内径，快速判断能否装入、最多装几件，减少拆箱重包。: Pre-shipment packing check: enter product and carton inner dimensions to see if it fits and how many fit, reducing unpacking and repacking.
map.仓储拣货配箱：按订单件数与商品尺寸选择箱型，避免大箱装小件造成填充物浪费与运费上: Warehouse carton selection: choose carton sizes by order quantity and product dimensions, avoiding oversized cartons that waste filler and raise shipping costs.
map.软包装预留：用缓冲余量模拟气泡膜厚度，提前判断加缓冲后是否仍能装入。: Cushion allowance: model bubble-wrap thickness to check whether items still fit after cushioning.
map.算例：物品 25×18×10 cm、纸箱内径 40×30×25 cm、2 件: Example: 25×18×10 cm item, 40×30×25 cm carton inner size, 2 units
map.按物品 25 长、18 宽、10 高对应箱 40×30×25：每轴可放 ⌊40÷: With item 25 length, 18 width and 10 height against a 40×30×25 cm carton: ⌊40÷26⌋=1, ⌊30÷19⌋=1 and ⌊25÷11⌋=2, so 2 units fit. Rotated to 18×25×10: ⌊40÷19⌋=2, ⌊30÷26⌋=1 and ⌊25÷11⌋=2, so 4 units fit, which is better. Item volume is 4.5 L and carton volume 30 L; with 2 units, space utilization is about 30%.
map.为什么同一个箱子换个方向能多装？: Why can the same carton hold more when the item is rotated?
map.纸箱三边长度不同，把物品较短的边对齐箱子较长的边，往往能在该方向多放一件。工具会: Carton sides differ in length. Aligning a shorter item edge with a longer carton edge often fits one more unit along that axis. The tool tests all six orientations and takes the maximum.
map.单侧间隙应该留多少？: How much clearance should I leave?
map.普通纸箱建议每侧 0.3–0.5 cm，方便取放并抵消纸箱内径公差；加气泡膜或珍: For a standard carton, leave 0.3-0.5 cm per side for handling and inner-dimension tolerance. When adding bubble wrap or EPE foam, include the cushion thickness in the clearance or soft-pack allowance.
map.算出来能装，为什么实际还是盖不上？: Why does the calculation say it fits but the carton will not close?
map.常见原因是纸箱内径标注为外径、纸板厚度与压痕占用空间、物品鼓包或缓冲材料压缩后回: Common causes are using outer instead of inner dimensions, board thickness and creases taking up space, bulging items or cushioning rebounding after compression. Measure the inner dimensions and allow 5%-10% margin.
map.混装不同商品怎么算？: How do I calculate mixed items?
map.本工具按同一物品、同一朝向整齐码放计算。混装时应先按最大件校核，再人工排布或用装: This tool assumes one item type packed uniformly in one orientation. For mixed loads, check the largest item first, then arrange manually or use a bin-packing algorithm; trial-pack when shapes differ substantially.

map.同一朝向单箱件数 = ⌊箱长 ÷ 件长⌋ × ⌊箱宽 ÷ 件宽⌋ × ⌊箱高 ÷: Units per carton in one uniform orientation = ⌊carton length ÷ item length⌋ × ⌊carton width ÷ item width⌋ × ⌊carton height ÷ item height⌋, taking the maximum across six orientations. This is not the global optimum for mixed orientations.
map.六种朝向来自物品长宽高的全排列；工具取“同一朝向整齐码放”件数最多的朝向作为推荐: The six orientations are all permutations of item length, width and height. The tool recommends the orientation with the most units packed uniformly in one orientation and does not search mixed-orientation layouts.
map.计算假设物品为规则长方体，且同一朝向整齐码放；“同向不足”不等于混合朝向一定装不: The calculation assumes regular rectangular items packed uniformly in one orientation. A shortfall in one orientation does not prove a mixed layout cannot fit; irregular, cylindrical and mixed loads need a trial pack.
map.电商发货前试装：输入商品与纸箱内径，快速评估同一朝向能否装下、同向最多几件；同向: Pre-shipment trial packing: enter product and carton inner dimensions to check whether the quantity fits in one uniform orientation and how many fit; a shortfall does not prove mixed packing cannot fit—this reduces unpacking and repacking.
map.纸箱三边长度不同，把物品较短的边对齐箱子较长的边，往往能在该方向多放一件。工具会: Carton sides differ in length; aligning an item’s shorter side with the carton’s longer side often allows one more item along that axis. The tool checks six uniform orientations and takes the largest count, which is not the global optimum for mixed orientations.
map.算出来同向能装，为什么实际还是盖不上？: The uniform calculation fits, but the lid still will not close—why?
map.常见原因是纸箱内径标注为外径、纸板厚度与压痕占用空间、物品鼓包或缓冲材料压缩后回: Common causes are cartons whose inner size is actually an outer dimension, board thickness and flutes taking up space, bulging items or cushioning that rebounds after compression. Measure the inner dimensions and leave a 5%–10% allowance; trial-pack mixed, tilted or irregular loads.
map.算例：物品 25×18×10 cm、纸箱内径 40×30×25 cm、单侧间隙: Example: item 25×18×10 cm, carton inner size 40×30×25 cm, 0.5 cm clearance per side, 0% cushion allowance, 2 items
map.有效尺寸 = 25+1、18+1、10+1 = 26×19×11 cm。按 26: Effective size = 25+1, 18+1, 10+1 = 26×19×11 cm. Against the 40×30×25 cm carton: ⌊40÷26⌋=1, ⌊30÷19⌋=1, ⌊25÷11⌋=2, giving 2 units in that uniform orientation; rotated to 19×26×11: ⌊40÷19⌋=2, ⌊30÷26⌋=1, ⌊25÷11⌋=2, giving 4 units, which is better. Item volume 4.5 L, carton volume 30 L; 2 items use about 30% of the space. Note: the page default 10% cushion allowance changes the effective size to 28.5×20.8×12 cm, with a uniform maximum of 3 (the 12 cm edge fits 3 along the 40 cm carton length); set the allowance to 0% to reproduce 4. Those 4 units still reflect a single uniform orientation, not the global optimum for mixed orientations.
